slides.title: Northfield closes in [[5 days]] and saves $4.2M a year
slides.source: Source: West Monroe analysis of the FY26 baseline; run-rate after wave 3.

node.text: Automated matching clears the intercompany balances that today take three people four days each month. Moving review to the point of posting means exceptions are fixed on day one instead of being found on day nine.
Together they remove about 11,000 hours of manual effort a year across the 14 business units, and let the controller sign off on day five without adding headcount.

slides.title: Lakeview closes in [[6 days]] and saves $3.8M a year
slides.source: Source: West Monroe analysis of the FY26 baseline; run-rate after wave 3.

node.text: Automated matching clears exceptions daily. Controllers review issues as entries post, with one owner for each exception and a shared six-day close calendar.
The first three waves cover 12 units. Removing repeated checks releases finance capacity and creates a clear audit trail without adding headcount.
